title: Rapid Model Tryouts Lab: customer probes for switchability
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Objective: run short, instrumented customer tryouts to measure how easily mid-market customers can swap models/providers for latency-sensitive workloads (RAG, search, summarization). Outcome will be a prioritized ‘switchability’ heatmap and concrete mitigation playbooks for the sales/SRE flows.

Why now: rising open-model supply volatility + customers asking about fallback options. We need empirical data on real integration friction (prompt tuning, output regression, infra changes) to recommend product investments (console flows, APIs, prebuilt adapters).

Scope: 6 customer tryouts across 3 verticals (FinServ, SaaS analytics, Healthcare startups). Each tryout is 2 weeks with: baseline with current provider, 7-day trial with 2 candidate open models (quantized and full-precision), and a short wrap interview. Instrumentation includes token counts, per-request latency, quality delta on a 10-case prompt set, and developer integration effort logs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Completed tryouts with at least 5/6 customers finishing instrumentation and interviews.
2) Final switchability heatmap (models x friction vectors) with documented scoring rubric.
3) Three recommended mitigations/playbooks (quick-runbook for Sales, SRE checklist for fallbacks, and a minimal Console UX mock for model substitution).
4) Deck + appendix with raw metrics, anonymized qualitative notes, and sample prompts for reproducibility.
research_plan:
1) Recruit customers via AE contacts; target mix: 2 FinServ, 2 SaaS analytics, 2 Healthcare.
2) Onboarding doc + one-hour kickoff per customer (shared Confluence doc).
3) Provide sandbox credentials, sample evaluation harness (GitHub repo) and a measurement dashboard prototype.
4) Two-week timeline per customer: Day 0 baseline, Days 1-7 candidate A, Days 8-14 candidate B, final interview Day 15.
5) Collect: latency traces, per-token cost estimate, test-set quality scores (BLEU/ROUGE/semantic-sim), prompt iteration time logged by developer, integration blockers recorded in a shared ticketing board.
6) Synthesize into switchability rubric across 5 axes: Integration Effort, Latency Delta, Cost Delta, Quality Regression, Legal/Compliance Friction.
metrics:
- Completion rate: target >= 83% (5/6).
- Median latency increase vs baseline (ms).
- Median per-token cost delta (%).
- Average quality regression (semantic score delta).
- Developer integration time (hours).
- NPS-like switch willingness score from interviews (0-10).
deliverables:
- Switchability heatmap CSV and PNG.
- 12-page synthesis deck for GTM + Eng leadership.
- 3 playbooks: Sales quick-runbook, SRE fallback checklist, Console microflow spec.
- GitHub repo with evaluation harness and reproducible scripts.
- Confluence page with anonymized interview transcripts and decision log.
